host.ask: IP address or host name of the freeze dryer's control PLC (Modbus TCP)
host.help: The LyoStar's control system (LyoS / SCADA PC or the PLC behind it) has an Ethernet port; SP service or your SCADA engineer knows its address and whether Modbus TCP is enabled. Port 502 is assumed; put `port` in config.json if yours differs. For Modbus RTU use `serial_port` and `baud` instead of `host`.

unit.help: 1 unless the PLC or gateway was configured otherwise.
